title: Owner-document status lines are stale against roadmap closure (EVOL-X architecture, ENT-AUDIT-X architecture, PDC ownership matrix, ADR-PDC-05 body)
impact: Canonical owner docs read as draft/pending (EVOL-X: W1 draft ADR, OD-EVOL-01 pending approval; ENT-AUDIT-X: FRZ-AUD-01..10 OPEN at implementation; PDC ownership matrix: draft pending OD-PDC-ADR-01 although the ADRs record it Accepted; ADR-PDC-05 status Accepted but section says proposed; matrix says application_artifacts.py is removed while it exists as a shim). A reader using the authority hierarchy gets conflicting stage state; roadmap status is authoritative.
recommendation: Owners refresh status headers to the closed/accepted state with date and SHA, or mark them explicitly historical; correct the matrix row to say shim retained (0 importers).
decision_authority: Roadmap (S01) for status; owner docs for semantics

title: Two unrelated ProofReceipt models and two ProofReceiptStore definitions share names across platform and Tier-3
impact: PROOF_RECEIPTS.md names intergrax/proofs/receipts/contracts.py as the platform ProofReceipt owner; a second portable attested ProofReceipt (plus V2) lives in contracts/execution_evidence and is aliased in consumers. The governed contractor app also defines its own ProofReceiptStore Protocol and SQLite/in-memory stores. Semantic confusion and possible parallel evolution; no evidence of runtime conflict. DUP-X documents contain no ProofReceipt disposition.
recommendation: Decide and document the canonical vocabulary (rename or explicitly scope each model) and add the execution-evidence receipt and store port to PROOF_RECEIPTS.md or a reconciling evidence-plane doc.
decision_authority: Architecture docs (domain semantics); DUP-X for duplicate disposition

title: Most Tier-3 application entrypoints start serving with direct uvicorn.run instead of the hosting lifecycle engine
impact: The PDC D4 ownership matrix names run_hosted_application as the hosting composition root, but only local_workspace_application/hosting/foreground.py calls it; six verified entrypoints (including LKW host/main.py) call uvicorn.run directly, so readiness, ordered shutdown, instance guard and supervised restart of the hosting engine are not applied on those paths. The docs describe LKW as first adopter and do not declare direct serving an accepted alternative. Whether this violates a frozen invariant depends on PROD-Q scope.
recommendation: Operator/owner decision: document direct ASGI serving as an accepted scoped path (with the invariants it forgoes) or require adoption of the hosting engine; add a gate counting uvicorn.run in applications/*/host.
decision_authority: PDC ownership matrix; PROD-Q for production lifecycle qualification

title: Owner documents for QUAL-X, the evidence plane and RI-01 sit outside the architecture layer; five Tier-2 agents are absent from the agents registry doc
impact: grep over docs/project architecture, capabilities, maintainers/architecture and plans finds QUAL-X only in the EVOL-X doc and the roadmap; the evidence plane and runtime invariant service are owned by plan/qualification records; agents boundary_demo, external_contractor_adapter, model_routing_qualifier, tool_selection_qualifier and web_search_qualifier are not in the agents/README.md registry table. Ownership is discoverable only through PDC matrices or qualification records.
recommendation: Add architecture-layer owner entries (or explicit pointers) for QUAL-X, the evidence plane and RI-01, and register the five agents.
decision_authority: Roadmap and AGENTS.md documentation pairing rule

title: intergrax/globals has no owner and hardcodes Poland-specific import-time defaults
affected_invariant: agent-env env-config rule (typed configuration contracts; no silent defaults) / FRZ-CFG
impact: GlobalSettings reads INTERGRAX_DEFAULT_* env vars with literal defaults pl, pl-PL, pl-PL and Europe/Warsaw at import time (12 importing modules including integrations and runtime nexus session manager). No architecture, plan or PDC document names the package. Low severity: locale defaults do not widen authority, but they are a silent default outside the documented configuration reference.
recommendation: Assign an owner (CONFIG-X/C12), document the variables in PLATFORM_CONFIGURATION or move defaults into the typed profile.

title: ProofReceipt provenance invariants (source revision, dirty state, environment fingerprint) are documented as not implemented
impact: The canonical DocumentStore ProofReceipt carries no mandatory execution provenance; a receipt alone cannot support a current-state certification claim. The document records this as accepted/planned, and a separate qualification validity record stores source_revision for provider qualification only.
recommendation: Operator decides whether LKW proof receipts may be cited as certification evidence before the provenance fields exist; until then cite them only as historical evidence.
